== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Card list text)|Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata)]] (Virtual Block 2 slip 58), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published full card image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Defensive Fire (V) (Virtual Block 2)]] (original).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. "non-Permanent weapon" as written there.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “If opponent just initiated battle, you may immediately fire one non-lightsaber, non-Permanent weapon present in that battle once (for free), adding 2 to each of its destiny draws. That weapon may fire again this battle.”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1002_L6242</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>4_140</code>, title, lore, icons, set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
